name: NASA GIBS imagery
description: Satellite imagery from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) as aerial basemaps, for a day you pick: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 at about 30 m per pixel and VIIRS at about 250 m. No API key is needed. The imagery is too coarse to see streets or track.

basemaps.label: NASA HLS Sentinel-2
basemaps.note: About 30 m per pixel (38 m on this map), from one day's satellite passes: parts of the map are empty or cloudy, so try another date. Too coarse to draw track or kerbs.

attribution.text: NASA GIBS: HLS Sentinel-2 (HLSS30 v2.0), contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data

basemaps.label: NASA HLS Landsat 8 and 9
basemaps.note: About 30 m per pixel (38 m on this map), from one day's satellite passes: parts of the map are empty or cloudy, so try another date. Too coarse to draw track or kerbs.

attribution.text: NASA GIBS: HLS Landsat 8 and 9 (HLSL30 v2.0), courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

basemaps.label: NASA VIIRS true colour
basemaps.note: The whole world each day at about 250 m per pixel (306 m on this map), with clouds: for regional context only.

attribution.text: NASA GIBS: VIIRS NOAA-20 Corrected Reflectance
